title: Refine Optimize evaluation acceptance criteria, prompt-set sampling, and automated rollback rules
creator: Asha Rangan
description: PRD-level clarification for Optimize: define concrete acceptance criteria, prompt-set sampling rules, A/B decision logic, and automated rollback triggers. This ticket consolidates prior research notes and aligns Product / Eng / SRE / Safety on thresholds and procedures before the next rollout window. Deliverable: a single-page acceptance checklist and a companion 'playbook' doc with required dashboards and alert hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Primary acceptance document published in Confluence with final thresholds, signed off by Eng lead (Miguel) and Safety (R. Chen)
Prompt-set sampling artifact (CSV + metadata) covering >=500 examples per vertical and stratified by top 10 intents and two traffic tiers (head/tail)
A/B evaluation harness returns statistically significant results (p < 0.05) for all reported metrics or reports inconclusive with minimum sample size note
Composite score improvement: treatment must beat control by >=0.75 points on the weighted composite or meet the multi-metric pass rule (see A/B criteria)
No single high-impact safety category shows an absolute regression >0.1% (critical safety categories defined in Safety matrix); any such regression requires manual hold and investigation
Latency SLOs must hold: p95 latency increase <= 20% and median latency increase <= 10%; if exceeded, rollback is automatic unless a compensating config is approved
Cost per 1k tokens (estimated) must not increase by >5% without Finance approval
Rollout plan with canary windows, monitoring dashboards and alert thresholds listed; on-call runbook linked
Automated rollback rules implemented in rollout orchestration (canary controller) and validated in staging
scope_in: Define numeric thresholds for Optimize evals (composite + individual metrics)
Specify prompt-set composition and sampling process for each customer vertical and for global tests
Define A/B decision logic and minimal sample sizes for common traffic levels
Define automated rollback triggers and required mitigation paths
Create a short playbook for Engineering and SRE to run pre-rollout checks
scope_out: Building new model training pipelines (this ticket only specifies eval/rollout rules)
Full redesign of Optimize UI dashboards (small dashboard templates only)
Contract negotiations with customers for Dedicated/Private plans
decisions: Use a weighted composite score: 40% quality (human eval), 30% helpfulness (heuristic + human), 15% safety (automated safety suite), 15% latency/cost penalty
Minimum sample size for user-level A/B: 10k sessions OR 200k tokens, whichever is larger, for high-variance workloads
Adopt two-tier rollback policy: automatic immediate rollback for safety-critical or latency SLO breaches; manual investigation hold for small quality regressions
Prompt-sets must include 10% adversarial/paraphrase variants and 5% synthetic edge-cases generated by fuzzing harness
open_questions: Do we require separate safety thresholds for regulated verticals (finance/healthcare)? (PM to confirm with Legal)
Should we treat cost increases differently for beta customers on trial credits?
What is the migration plan for existing prompt-sets already used in Optimize v1? (content owners: Solutions Eng)
Approve final composite weighting for non-English locales (proposal: same weights but validate)
